criteria.fail: Calls it a complete split or treats an existing beneficiary as established.

criteria.requirement: Correct the CFO's complete-transfer and company-extinction assertions using partial universal succession.

criteria.requirement: Translate the ledger into affirmative draft allocation of both assets and liabilities, not just an asset list.

criteria.fail: Lists only assets, silently drops debts or incorrectly computes the stated 8:4 planning figures.

Does not present the claim as presently known or the fallback as already operative.
criteria.fail: Calls a future hypothetical claim presently incurred, makes the fallback automatic despite an interpretable final project, uses general article 1031-1 solidarity instead, or excludes Meridian from the conditional 2:1 illustration.

EUR 8 million to North and EUR 4 million retained by Meridian (2:1)

criteria.minimalPass: Allocate known debt in drafting; only if a later EUR 900k claim escapes final terms and interpretation, the illustrative 8:4 split gives North EUR 600k and Meridian EUR 300k.
criteria.nearMiss: The warranty claim is currently unallocated, so EUR 600k/EUR 300k is already legally fixed before approval.

criteria.requirement: Separate the allocated supplier debt from conditional future secondary creditor recourse, using the effective-date value cap rather than treating EUR 4m planning estimate as fixed.
criteria.pass: North would be the primary allocated debtor after legal effect; only if the supplier creditor then fails to obtain satisfaction from North may Meridian face statutory secondary joint-and-several recourse, capped at the value of Meridian's attributed net assets on the legally effective date. EUR 4m is only the plan estimate and may be an indicative cap if that effective-date valuation is confirmed.
criteria.fail: Says creditor can never pursue Meridian, asserts present failed collection or unlimited Meridian liability, or unconditionally certifies EUR 4m as the effective-date cap despite missing valuation.

These are planning figures, not stipulated values at legal effect.

criteria.minimalPass: North primary; only upon future failed satisfaction can Meridian be secondarily liable, capped by its effective-date net-asset value; EUR 4m is merely indicative until verified.
